results.title: Les tremblements
results.overview: Three brothers meet to go to the bedside of their sick mother. While she is dying, her husband and sons will try to survive her. As best they can, the father organizes daily life in silent distress while his sons do not know how to cope with the approaching death.

results.title: The Diplomat
results.overview: The Deputy High Commissioner, J.P. Singh, faces an unusual crisis when a mysterious woman rushes inside the Indian High Commission in Islamabad, claiming forced marriage in Pakistan and seeking a return to India.

results.title: What We Hide
results.overview: After their mother dies of an overdose, two sisters hide her body to avoid being separated by the foster system, but as their secret threatens to unravel, they must confront the consequences of their desperate choice.

results.title: Longing
results.overview: A single mother faces a deep sense of unease when her successful eldest child returns home and treats her with indifference, while her simple, humble youngest child shows her a love that is irreplaceable.

results.title: Elmo and Mark Rober's Merry Giftmas
results.original_title: Elmo and Mark Rober's Merry Giftmas
results.overview: Elmo and his Sesame Street friends work with former NASA engineer turned YouTube star Mark Rober to make special presents for a Merry Giftmas exchange.

results.title: A Losing Game
results.overview: A Losing Game follows three people who ran for office in the 2022 Quebec provincial election, casting a critical eye on its electoral system and the many ways in which it is dysfunctional.

results.title: Love Me Tender
results.overview: At the end of summer, Clémence tells her ex-husband that she’s had relationships with women. Her life is turned upside down when he files to strip her of their son’s custody. Then begins a struggle of several years for Clémence to defend her right to be a mother and a woman – free to make her own choices.

results.title: Crazy Old Lady
results.overview: Pedro receives a desperate message from an ex-girlfriend asking him to look after her senile mother, Alicia. What seems like a simple mission soon becomes his worst nightmare. Pedro needs to escape; but Alicia won’t let him...

results.title: Dead Actually
results.overview: In a dark, rural comedy, four friends face macabre setbacks (hiding a corpse, outwitting a scheming daughter, and thwarting a son-in-law's plans) to protect their secret.

results.title: Delusyon
results.overview: A desperate wife whose husband is shot after a robbery attempt. Desperate to help him financially, she turns to Kap, a man who's always been interested in her, sparking an affair that shatters their relationships.

results.title: Island Life
results.overview: A one-shot thriller about a gang leader who refuses to confront the neighbour suddenly blasting music at six in the morning.

results.title: Fish, Fists and Ambergris
results.overview: The treasured relic of Long Diên Hương fishing village is stolen, setting off a thrilling pursuit. Beyond its spectacular martial arts sequences, the film delivers laughter, unity, and the heartfelt human values of the coastal villagers.

results.title: Love Machine
results.overview: Mia receives her first sex bot and tries to make it work.

results.title: All In
results.overview: Emilė always lives ten steps ahead: she knows how things should be. That doesn't help her on an awkward date - a poker party where everyone lives in the moment.

results.title: Tuna Tartare
results.overview: In a karaoke bar in post-apocalyptic Los Angeles, an expired can of tuna fish and a fake Louis Vuitton purse encourage each other to believe in their artistic voices even if the world sees them as trash.

results.title: Club Tropicana
results.overview: Movie about some person or something

results.title: Janur Ireng
results.original_title: Janur Ireng: Sewu Dino the Prequel
results.overview: After losing their family home in a devastating fire, two impoverished siblings accept the hospitality of a wealthy long-lost uncle, unaware that his grand estate holds a sinister plot to exploit them.

results.title: La sélection
results.overview: Raphaël, a photographer in search of recognition, has to take the portrait of a Korean singer visiting Paris. After a laborious photo shoot, he is forced to select the images with Lucie, a member of the celebrity's team. With their different points of view, they gradually learn to get to know each other.

results.title: Fire Breather
results.overview: A reclusive father and his daughter find themselves in the crosshairs of a battle between dragons and the Military.

results.title: The Book of Sijjin & Illiyyin
results.overview: As a child, Yuli witnessed her parents die at the hands of a mysterious force after her mother became possessed. Branded a cursed and unwanted child, she survived and grew up under the roof of her father's other wife Ambar and her daughter Laras, enduring constant humiliation. Fueled by vengeance, Yuli performs a forbidden ritual. As the dark magic takes root, the world around her begins to unravel.
